title: Blocks With Borders
description: Adds borders to important blocks like ores and suspiscious blocks! With major mod support!
body:
BlocksWithBorders Vanilla Features

- Vanilla Blocks
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f80735c9e48d2a0c176e937003dcbdbf55cd92f5.png)
 
Emissive & Connected textures supported with [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) and ~~Optifine~~!

Connected textures are in the CTM beta pack!
